answer: A farm running 96 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. Because the vine stake is held until the oasis settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the thread audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 30% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
